note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in Fermanagh took place on Wednesday 31 May 1933 and the results were declared on Thursday 1 June. The Drummee division was the only contest in this district. Filed on 1933-05-31, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The Impartial Reporter of 4 May 1933, p. 5, lists the nominations for twenty-five divisions (added 6 Nov 2026); Monea, a division in 1930 and 1936, is not in the printed list; its member, Thomas Elliott, J.P., is placed there by elimination (see the Monea contest). Dowler held his seat. Majority 46. No change.
correctionNote: Corrected (council-audit, Nov 2026): the round note no longer says Monea is not filled here; gapfill-fermanagh places Thomas Elliott, J.P., there by elimination (Fermanagh Herald, 10 June 1933, p. 5).
